name: Twilight Mementos
summary: Sergeant Riftan sends you north to Krol'dok Stronghold after scouts confirm a Twilight's Hammer hideout. He asks you to bring back proof of the cultists' defeat.

sections.title: Scouts' Reports
sections.body: Scouts have brought Sergeant Riftan grim accounts of a cultist hideout. Their reports confirm what others have said. A cave lies north, concealed by its surroundings, and Riftan believes it gives the cult a foothold deep in the mountains. He sends you to Krol'dok Stronghold to bring back proof that the Twilight's Hammer cultists have been defeated.

faq.q: Who is asking me to go north?
faq.answer: Sergeant Riftan asks you to seek out the Twilight's Hammer cultists at Krol'dok Stronghold and return with proof of their defeat.
The scouts' accounts confirmed reports of a cultist hideout, with a concealed cave to the north.
The hideout is in a cave to the north, concealed by its surroundings. Riftan believes it is a foothold deep in the mountains.
Riftan asks you to bring back proof that the cultists at Krol'dok Stronghold have been defeated.
They are members of the Twilight's Hammer, whose hideout has been confirmed by the scouts' reports.
